text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, making them ideal for structured information. NoSQL databases are more flexible and handle unstructured data well. To work with data, we use queries—special commands that retrieve or modify information. Good data modeling helps organize how data connects and relates, which improves performance and keeps things clear. Indexes also play an important role by speeding up searches, especially in large tables. Together, these concepts form the foundation of modern database systems.
